description: This file contains a unit test for the Router class from the litellm package, specifically testing the shallow copy behavior of default deployment objects to ensure modifications in copies do not affect the original.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Class imported from the litellm package representing a router handling model deployments.

methods.name: test_default_deployment_isolation()
methods.description: Unit test function validating that shallow copies of default deployments are correctly isolated at the top-level dictionary and litellm_params, while nested objects are intentionally shared.
